body: Polycab NSE filing 30-Oct-2026: NCLAT order setting aside the NCLT Ahmedabad CIRP admission (CA(AT)(Ins) 1940/2026; plausible pre-existing dispute). LiveLaw, Bar & Bench concur. A 25-Nov-2026 headline ('NCLAT reserves order') was stale. Immaterial to margins; may be appealed to SC.
title: Polycab India: NCLAT sets aside NCLT order admitting CIRP over Rs 2.78 cr Asier Metals claim (30-Oct-2026)
